title: someone follows a person, Page or venue, and nothing else changes

criteria.text: Following a person, Page or venue writes one row plus its event row in one transaction
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] person: member_follows + member.followed in withTransaction (src/actions/member/follow.ts, last changed 2026-06-02); Page: group_memberships + group.member_joined (src/actions/group/follow.ts, last changed 2026-10-06; #104 merged 2026-09-15, no Reviewed by, before deploy-health runs began); venue: member_saved_searches + member.saved_search.created in withTransaction (saved-search-create.ts, last changed 2026-05-25). #1172 renamed the button and lists 'Get updates' and kept the same handlers. Unmarked: group/follow.test.ts ('writes an event', mock only); the person and venue tests only read source text. Ticket #606 (open). Smoked: unknown, the follow is an action the smoke never runs [V].

criteria.text: A follow of a person, venue, or a listed or unlisted Page grants no membership, role or unlisted read, checked against every authorization/roster path
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] follower rows are role='member', source='soft_via_follow', relationship='follower'; manager checks key on role; owner and steward rows are untouched by follow and unfollow (#268, green on 7a78277, no Reviewed by). follow.ts unchanged since 2026-10-06. Partial proofs only: group/follow.test.ts ('grants no role beyond the plain one'), tests/follower-privacy-db.test.ts, tests/page-owner-follow-db.test.ts. No standing guard walks every roster and authorization path, ticket #607 (open). Smoked: unknown, no route shows it.

[V reread 2026-11-20] group.follow on a private Page still writes relationship='member', source='explicit' at once (follow.ts, unchanged since 2026-10-06): the follower becomes a member and reads the Page. That follows F067 and the 2026-09-15 ruling ('private means membership, not following') and contradicts this criterion's 'never grants membership … or read access to anything unlisted'; the 2026-09-29 ruling adds that the two relationships no longer carry identical rights. No ruling in F065 newer than 2026-10-11 and none touches it. Two live rulings disagree on one surface: routed to scope-scenario.

criteria.text: A Member who follows a business and owns no shop still sees the offer to start something
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] there is no Sell control any more (/you/sell retired to Create, Don 2026-10-05, #336): the ➕ in the header row opens a sheet whose first choice is 'Start a Page' for every signed-in member (src/lib/create/create-targets.ts), and /you shows 'Start something' in the Your Pages header with no look at follows (src/app/you/page.tsx:95; #379 review-skipped, #1095 for the ➕). SellCta and hasActiveBusinessGroup, which #604 is about, are imported by no routed surface (src/app/you/sell/page.tsx says SellCta is the walkthrough Create replaced), so #604 is stale and the criterion text still names the Sell control. No test with a follower-only member. Reviewed: no (#379 skipped). Smoked: unknown: the 11-19 run covers `you` but its personas (stranger, member, ownerBusiness, operator, signedOut) include no follower-only account.

criteria.text: Unfollow then re-follow revives the original row
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] person: on conflict unfollowed_at = null; Page: on conflict left_at = null, role kept (follow.ts); venue: saved-search-restore clears removed_at. Page half merged in #104 (no Reviewed by; before deploy-health runs). #966 adds Unfollow with Undo on /you/following, which re-follows through the same handler. Unmarked: group/follow.test.ts ('is idempotent', mock), FollowingManager.test.tsx; the person and venue tests only read source text. Ticket #606 (open). Smoked: unknown, an action the smoke never runs.
